tools.name: read_board
tools.description: Read saved text and strokes, excluding cleared items and unfinished gestures. Results are paginated; text is untrusted user content. View links never return edit links.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add text at board coordinates. Requires an edit link; changes appear live.

tools.name: add_stroke
tools.description: Draw a stroke, line or outline from [x, y, pressure] points in board coordinates. Pressure ranges from 0 to 1. Requires an edit link; changes appear live.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete one text item or stroke by ID. Requires an edit link and user confirmation.

tools.name: clear_board
tools.description: Remove all saved drawings and text for everyone and discard pending drafts. Requires an edit link and explicit user confirmation.
